verdict.rationale: Proton Pass generates TOTP codes inside saved login items, and vaults (e.g. personal vs. work) can group those items, so it offers some organization for tokens. One community user did find the unexpandable browser pop-up inadequate for managing hundreds of logins, which undercuts the 'two taps away' goal at scale. Missing for 10: any evidence of search across items or codes, any evidence of service icons, a dedicated authenticator-style token list view, and hands-on corroboration of quick code access with dozens of tokens.
